critic_risk_flags: Although H maps directly to the hospitalization-rate target, adding an explicit H compartment in SEIHR is likely weakly identifiable in a short single-season series (31 train weeks), with substantial risk of confounding between I progression and H dynamics. This increases over-complexity relative to delayed_I alternatives that already match the stated surveillance semantics.

I+H is poorly aligned to a hospitalization-rate target unless the surveillance signal truly mixes admissions with occupancy; the proposal’s own failure mode highlights this ambiguity. It also inherits SEIHR identifiability concerns and adds additional mapping ambiguity (mixture weights implicitly fixed), increasing risk of misattributing shape/level in short data.
